description: Financing for 192MW site in Finland + 264 MW in Norway

history.from: x CLA launch 10/21; credit approvals requested by 11/24 x Finalization DD pack with TDD on critical path (pending 100% design in Norway and E&S) x Rating advice expected by end of October
history.to: x CLA feedback (lead banks' deck 10/29): ABN AMRO, BBVA, BNPP, ING, SMBC positive; MS, MUFG TBD (MUFG gave feedback to ECX directly, ECX to follow up); LBBW declined (credit) x Institutional sounding (12 investors): of interest, but no investor will take the deal as presented (pricing vs IG DC bonds, tight DSCR / extension risk, preference for fixed rate with MW). Allianz, CPPIB, NYL declined; Apterra on hold x Leads recommend a fixed-rate 7Y tranche at min. 250bps flat with make-whole (~EUR 1.15bn potential liquidity), a EUR [0.75-1.0]bn cornerstone institutional tranche, and possibly broadening the CLA list x ECX current thinking (Eelco 11/2): 7yr, 250bps; initial draw + fixed conservative draw schedule, banks for flex; indicated investor interest ~EUR 1.1bn. Norway fixed-rate with 3yr non-call / MW (targets Blackstone, MEAG, IFM); Finland floating, no non-call / MW (target PIMCO) x CLA launch 10/21; credit approvals requested by 11/24 x Finalization DD pack with TDD on critical path (pending 100% design in Norway and E&S) x Rating advice expected by end of October

issuesTechnical: - Challenging timeline to meet Norway Phase 3 power connection according to external source - 20-40MVA missing for Finland, no mitigant idenfied so far - E&S issues with impact on local communities
keyIssues: x Power in Norway will likely have to be financed in tranches x NOR restructuring w/ leases assigned to 6 separate entities x More focus on Norway because of location
